issues.detail: The Greek 'ηδη οζει' (already it stinks/smells) is translated as 'đã có mùi' (it has a smell/odor). While 'mùi' captures the sense of odor, the Greek 'οζει' specifically implies the process of decaying/reeking. More importantly, the Vietnamese omits the adverb 'ηδη' (already), which emphasizes the state of decay.
